en: The image is a vintage postcard depicting a busy pier area by the water. People are standing and walking along the pier, with boats moored alongside and others further out in the water. Several buildings and structures are visible on the pier, with a mix of colonial-era architecture and industrial elements. The water is calm, and the scene appears to be a port or harbor area.
